request.query: Hasse derivative of a constant polynomial is zero for nonzero order

items.name: Polynomial.derivative_ofNat
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) [inst_1 : n.AtLeastTwo], Polynomial.derivative (OfNat.ofNat n) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] 1 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R] {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] (Polynomial.C a) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) 1 = 0
